grades.quote: The 12-bit B-immediate encodes signed offsets in multiples of 2 bytes. The offset is sign-extended and added to the address of the branch instruction to give the target address.
grades.reason: RISC-V spec section on conditional branches (including BEQ) directly states the target is the sign-extended B-immediate offset (multiples of 2 bytes) added to the branch instruction's address.
Describes LoongArch BEQZ/BNEZ target calculation, which is the wrong ISA for a RISC-V BEQ query.
